steps: Department page lists only current tenant departments.
Create/rename/disable flat department; roster picker contains only active same-tenant members.

Before confirmation show the fixed warning: this tenant authorization edit invalidates existing temporary credentials and views and requires renewal. Do not display an exact or estimated affected authorization/credential count; existing DTOs do not provide one.

One setDepartment command atomically replaces metadata+complete roster under one version. Other active same-tenant users may list enabled department names/IDs only; roster and member counts stay null.

Use listModules for this native tenant/domain. Actual owner summaries include disabled modules and owner policy CAS state version0/false if no row; ownership is metadata administration only. Existing native source/publication pickers are reused.
Existing owner builds a normal fixed content0.2 publication with current model gates unchanged.
New Access tab defaults off. Explicitly enable sharing.

Create an access module by selecting a subset of that publication; preview exact fixed source/revision/SHA and whole target units, conservative multi-source lineage requirements, no latest/group/path/node inheritance.
Create a time-bounded user or department grant; choose read/read_search and web_only/web_and_mcp separately.
Revoke grant or disable sharing/module; show that already delivered text cannot be recalled and subsequent requests are checked.

Updating a module version requires explicit replacement grants; old grants never inherit newly added targets. Owner module details include the current live grant list; no separate Grant/audit-query surface.

ModuleAdmin returns current sharing policy so policy CAS is reviewable after refresh; no additional policy-get or Grant-list API. A domain owner with no self grant uses the admin link and cannot mint a temporary credential implicitly.
Shared with me page lists only current permitted modules; no tenant/global source totals.

For read-only mode,inspect lists each fixed target with its unit_count. Open target_index/unit_ordinal0 through read,then use returned next_unit_ordinal or exact evidence_ref. No search authority or prior cached ref is required.
Choose requested mode/source subset; inspect creates a5minute fixed authorized view.
Search/read use new v0.3 DTO and evidence refs only; citation shows permitted fixed source and bounded typed summaries, not raw owner publication.
Any401/404/409 or expiry clears local shared view/text/ref query caches and requires an explicit fresh inspect; no background call to old owner endpoint.
limitations: No node ACL or rich raw typed payload
Search stable ID order, top20, no continuation/total count

flows.actor: native user with one qualifying grant
steps: Temporary MCP panel starts from a current native inspect view requested for web_and_mcp, and shows its exact target subset, domain/module version/subject/mode/expiry and external client delivery warning.
Only a native web_and_mcp view from one qualifying grant may mint a self credential. Copy its exact target subset to the credential; owner personal use also needs a self grant.
Choose requested mode<=grant and TTL default1h/max8h. Confirm client label is descriptive, not sender binding.
Token shown once in component memory; explicit copy only. Display endpoint URL separately. No file/QR/URL/telemetry/storage/history export.
Lost first response is handled through own credential metadata, explicit revoke and a new idempotency key. No recoverable token replay.
Credential list exposes safe metadata only, expiry, last use, revoke; no verifier or token fragment.

If a write response is lost,retry the same operation/key/body to resolve the durable receipt. Mint replay supplies metadata with token:null even after its old view expires; explicitly revoke/reissue only after resolution,not on an unknown commit.
flows.security_note: Receiving client can retain/forward text; this service does not enforce remote model policy after delivery.

client_configuration.managed_profile: Canonical HTTPS endpoint + Authorization: Bearer from client secret storage. No owner/API/model key and no extra X-Knowledge-MCP-Profile header.
client_configuration.compatibility: Named official Go/TS SDK versions and selected Agent integration must be tested later. Manual header support is not assumed for every Agent. OAuth-only hosts remain unsupported until separate OAuth decision.
client_configuration.server_responses: No-store, buffered JSON-only, no SSE/resumption. Origin/CORS allowlist for native Web, no wildcard credentialed CORS. Reject user-controlled target/audience URLs.
client_configuration.redirects: Client credential injection constrained to exact canonical endpoint; reject redirects and log redacted metadata only. Pin and test actual client behavior rather than assuming a custom header is safe everywhere.

client_cache.identity: actor user ID + native/restricted auth kind + credential ID + module version + view ID; never token plaintext
client_cache.lifecycle: Clear on logout/user switch,view TTL,401/404/409,revocation/module updates. Abort pending older views and guard storage writes with current identity/view. Browser already-delivered data cannot be forcibly recalled.
client_cache.secret_storage: No localStorage/sessionStorage/QueryClient cache/devtools/console for minted token. Close/unmount clears only local component references; no claim of guaranteed physical memory erasure.
